verdict.rationale: Algolia's core search engine is a hosted service, and a former customer describes its license as closed-source. The only open-source item in the evidence is InstantSearch.js, a frontend UI library. That is an adjacent client library, not the product's own source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: InstantSearch.js is an open source UI library for vanilla JS that lets you build a search interface in your frontend app.
They switched to Elasticsearch over price and the closed-source license.
